topic: Usopp's brave-warrior dream was set up in Little Garden chapters 116-117 and is now being paid off in Elbaph
title: Usopp's Elbaph Moment Was Planted In Chapter 116
description: Usopp's dream of being a brave warrior of the sea was born at Little Garden over twenty years ago. Here's the chain from chapters 116 and 117 to Elbaph. Is Usopp more than comic relief this arc?
tags: usopp brave warrior of the sea
comment: Is Usopp's big Elbaph moment still coming, or was chapter 1177 it? Pick one.

lines.text: Usopp's Elbaph moment was planted over twenty years ago.

shot.fallback: long nosed sniper looking up at giants

lines.text: Go back to Little Garden, chapter 116.

shot.fallback: prehistoric island with two giants dueling

lines.text: Dorry explains that he and Brogy are stuck in a hundred year duel.
And Dorry doesn't even remember why it started.
Then chapter 117 hits: Usopp decides he'll be a brave warrior of the sea, like those giants.

shot.search: Usopp brave warrior of the sea Dorry
shot.fallback: sniper staring up in awe at giant

lines.text: That dream is born right there, on a jungle island.
Fast forward to episode 1156. The Straw Hats reach Elbaph, and the episode opens on that exact flashback.

shot.fallback: straw hat crew arriving at a giant island

lines.text: Then in chapter 1177, Usopp rushes in to save Brook.
People say Usopp is just comic relief in this arc.
But Oda spent twenty years turning the land of giants into Usopp's finish line, and I think he's about to cash it in.

shot.fallback: sniper standing tall beside giant warriors

lines.text: Because Usopp's Elbaph moment was planted over twenty years ago.
